name: Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Limited
summary: Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Limited manufactures custom-made industrial and consumer goods in India and globally. The company operates through two segments: Manufacturing Business and Ecosystem Business. The company's Manufacturing Business segment designs, manufactures, supplies, and installs products across energy, precision, and capital goods verticals. Under energy products, it offers fabricated steel structures, solar modules, solar tracker structure equipment, and transformers.
